# fragata-server-backup-reports

> Backup reports plugin for XO-Server

## Usage

XO-Server plugin which sends email reports and Xmpp messages when backup jobs are done.

Like all other fragata-server plugins, it can be configured directly via
the web interface, see [the plugin documentation](https://github.com/6a8i/fragata-orchestrator/blob/main/docs/docs/backups-and-dr/backup_reports.md).
